crossRefs.note: This is according to all that you desired of Yahweh your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not…
He said, “Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands…
But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look…
For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t…
Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive…
But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those…
for our God is a consuming fire.

translations.web: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear Yahweh our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.
translations.bsb: But now, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us, and we will die, if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer.
translations.kjv: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.
translations.asv: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of Jehovah our God any more, then we shall die.
